target.measurement_rule: verified realized trailing-30-day income or binding next-30-day run rate

income_measurement.realized_reason: Authenticated payroll gross and payment proof remain unverified; do not treat the JPY 156,800 day-rate equivalent as realized pay.
income_measurement.contracted_reason: Future shift requests and historical night demand are not accepted assignments.

historical_night_evidence.conclusion: Historical employer night demand is verified; current accepted night income remains JPY 0.

forecast.reason: The corrected evidence removes the structural no-inventory interpretation but does not create a current safe accepted assignment or verified gross.
forecast.largest_uncertainty: Current accepted employment shifts, authenticated payroll gross, physical and return-travel safety for night work, and current event inventory.

usage_allocation.allocation: Codex and Spark normal; Claude reserve.

user_operation.rationale: No separate night-work request is added. The historical evidence is retained as a conditional option within the existing weekly form boundary only after the user independently confirms safety and a current option exists.

success_condition: Verified gross or binding next-30-day run rate reaches at least JPY 200,000.
withdrawal_condition: If the September payroll is below target or safe accepted shifts fail to materialize, promote a different employer/customer/channel layer.
effect_window: through 2026-09-25 payroll read-back, with maintenance remeasurement at least 30 days later
privacy: No employer name, person name, email, address, staff number, message identifier, account identifier, location, or secret is stored.
